legend: The Headless Horseman of Sleepy Hollow (New York, USA, Hessian ghost legend)
lines: Sleepy Hollow, New York. Every night, a rider waits on the lonely road.
They say he is a Hessian soldier from the Revolutionary War.
A cannonball took his head, and he was buried in the churchyard.
But each night his ghost rises, searching for the head he lost.
He gallops through the dark woods on a black horse.
Locals say he must be back in his grave before sunrise.
Travelers tell of hoofbeats thundering close behind them.
Their only hope is the old bridge by the church.
Cross it, and the rider cannot follow.
Would you dare ride that road at night?
title: The Headless Rider Who Gallops Through Sleepy Hollow Every Night #shorts
description:
In the legend of Sleepy Hollow, a headless Hessian horseman rides every night to find his lost head, and only a bridge by the church can stop him. An old American ghost story.
